title: Summary of his musical life before Boyd
summary: He sums up his pre-Boyd years: told he would be a doctor, his mother's teaching, listening to the moderns, and finding no teacher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I would say to describe my musical life before joining Boyd that it was one in which I had been told that I was going to be in medicine, I was going to become a doctor, which I didn't doubt, I just accepted blindly and one of feeling musical stirrings in me, recognizing that I had an appetite for music, but resenting the way it was presented to me by my mother and so, kicking a hole in the piano--
How do you kick a hole in a piano?
Well, it was an upright piano.
Okay; you must have had very sturdy shoes.

I had a lot of hate and anger, and you can kick big holes in pianos when you're very angry. That, plus listening to the great composers and really being drawn into music through their great talent, listening to the moderns of the present day and appreciating what they had done, enjoying that, and scratching
along, discovering that I had come across no system or no person that was able to bring knowledge that I required to me so that I could assimilate it.
